title: Part-time Work for Work Permit Holders
what_it_is: Part-time Work for Work Permit Holders

sections.label: Work Permit holders part-time work
sections.summary: The passage gives three reasons against allowing Work Permit holders to do part-time work and urges firms to become manpower-lean.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: First, we expect employers to bring in Work Permit holders for specific, full-time jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Work Permit holders should not have the time to engage in part-time work on top of the work for their primary employer.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Second, allowing part-time work may put Work Permit holders at risk of exploitation, especially if employers offer their Work Permit holders to do part-time work for other firms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Third, allowing part-time work may increase the overall demand for Work Permit holders, which would run counter to the national effort to restructure the economy and prevent over-reliance on foreign manpower.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Firms should address their manpower needs by becoming more manpower-lean, or by redesigning jobs to be more attractive to locals, rather than by relying more on foreign workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We offer support for companies through the Lean Enterprise Development (LED) scheme to transform and achieve manpower-lean growth.

sections.label: Redeployment within same company
sections.summary: The passage states that in the services industry, Work Permit holders may be redeployed across departments within the same company.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: For some industries, we do actually offer some flexibility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: For example, in the services industry, within the same company, we do allow them to redeploy their Work Permit holders across different departments within the same business, within the same company.
